scope: Offline lesson text and bilingual exercises.

lessonsRead.observation: Exact-order fix verified: the build now has four chips with 'essa ponte todos os dias' merged, capitalised 'Na minha infância' fixed first and the period chip last, so 'eu atravessava' must precede its object and only one order reconstructs; cloze cues 'esperar (Minha avó)'/'voltar (Minha avó)' tag subjects and DE/EN glosses stay idiomatic.

'no pátio da escola onde você estudou' matches the DE/EN geography; tinha sets the former state while trouxe/ganhou report the renovation as completed events with explicit subject cues; caption does not reveal the roof.

ficava + location and plural os bancos ficavam are correctly contrasted; comma-bearing 'da minha tia,' and period-bearing 'uma mangueira enorme.' lock the build order; cloze jogavam/contava distinguish plural vs singular subjects.

a gente jogava with 3sg verb honours the rule; 'até o sinal tocar' is lexical and the team-forming line (Dois colegas tiravam…formavam) is gender-free; DE 'Wenn viele mitmachen wollten' is a fair idiomatic paraphrase.
Habit (se reunia) versus turning point (vendeu, assumiu) is cleanly staged; cloze cues name 'Minha avó' and 'minha mãe'; recall on reunia with form distractors is fair.

'de quando ligava esse rádio' now reads unambiguously retrospective; tinha o hábito de + infinitivo stays within P8 licensing, and present-tense cloze leio/para (unaccented post-2009) matches the rule's switch to the present.

EN 'trying to hit a tin' now matches acertar; era + infinitive for the usual game, um dia + ensinou for the one occasion, valia with cue 'valer (cada acerto)' excludes valiam; recall on favorita tests agreement fairly.

Temporal logic holds (earlier arrival with two buses before; direct line then later departure); 'pegava' rendered as 'genommen habe' without added necessity; cues 'abrir (a linha direta)' and 'passar (eu)' make both blanks single-answer.

Second example 'Moro nesta rua há três anos, mas antes eu morava perto da praia' now shows the há + present duration the rule introduces; choice gaps dois/duas and aos/às/pelas/nas test real agreement and preposition points with one correct answer each.

faz dois anos + imperfeito me perdia + perfeito turning point (mostrou, comecei a caminhar) closes the path; chunk EN 'I've lived here' now models the correct English construction; caminhar is the only possible form after comecei a among the choices.

Atravessava marks the daily crossing; both verbs in the next answer agree with minha avó. The revised four-chip build reconstructs the canonical sentence exactly. Essa ponte todos os dias is correctly glossed in both base languages; checking all 24 orders confirms the previous alternative adverb placement is unavailable. Restoring only the prior chunk array reproduces the previously signed c8cb00d9e3c8c2d00051b9862793ed4fb7bb4f9237d27cce0a9e43867b0a55b5 hash.

Pátio da escola onde você estudou explicitly locates studying in the school, matching both translations; both scene captions quote the revised opening. Trouxe and ganhou describe the later renovations.
The bench and mangueira provide a concrete backdrop. O banco ficava and os bancos ficavam demonstrate the number contrast; cousins and aunt provide named subjects for the cloze.
A gente jogava uses a singular verb for the group; choosing teams by drawing names answers the follow-up about larger crowds. No Portuguese learner turn assigns the speaker gender.
The revised question now asks when the lunches changed houses, allowing the grandmother’s sale and the mother’s taking over to answer without assuming the learner’s own address.
Quando ligava is retrospective in the revised opening and both quoted captions. The old radio routine contrasts clearly with reading headlines while travelling today.
The full English learner line and the matching pattern now state that hitting the tin is the aim. The two-points-per-hit follow-up, vocabulary and chunk glosses agree.
The German use of genommen habe removes the former implication of necessity. The previous two-bus habit is contrasted with the completed opening of the direct service and its effect on departure.

At the staged L9 introduction, the new transfer sentence explicitly models moro + há três anos in a new setting and contrasts it with the imperfect morava. Both translations and the highlight preserve that contrast.

I’ve lived here now combines correctly with for two years now in the English chunks, matching the whole sentence. Faz with a present verb is taught in both residence and work contexts; the shortcut is the completed turning point.

lessonsRead.observation: The grandmother’s habitual wait answers the listener’s new question about company. The first-person imperfect and childhood setting avoid any learner-gender agreement. One build chip moves legitimately.

Tinha describes the old school, and trouxe/ganhou identify two renovation outcomes. The opening's Portuguese relative actually locates studying in the yard; both translations describe a yard at the school.
The bench and mango tree anchor the memory. The listener asks how the family used free afternoons; the plural and singular subjects control the two cloze verbs.
A gente jogava correctly introduces a group habit in the singular. An interested question about larger groups motivates the learner’s account of drawing team names.

Sunday lunches and the house sale illustrate imperfect habit vs completed events; the follow-up adds a previously unmentioned change of house. The optional transfer example currently illustrates only the habit.
The old radio habit contrasts with reading headlines on the bus today. Se lembrar de ligar is ambiguous between retrospective remembering and remembering to perform a task.
The cousin teaches a points rule after a question about variations. The original target is hitting the tin; the English full line only says throwing at it, despite its own chunk correctly saying hit.
The direct route removes the transfer and allows a later departure. A more idiomatic bus-service onset would improve the final Portuguese, and the German adds necessity to the old commute.

Weekly visits contrast with Sunday video calls after the move. The first ongoing-duration formula is correctly introduced here, with há dois anos. The transfer examples omit that newly taught construction.

Faz dois anos and the old tendency to get lost are distinct from the once-completed shortcut lesson; the job-duration example transfers the present-plus-faz pattern. The English chip tense models an error for this lesson.

findings.issue: Na minha infância eu atravessava todos os dias essa ponte para voltar para casa is another grammatical ordering with the same meaning. The build checks literal equality against the canonical string.
findings.recommendation: Bind the time adverb to the preceding or following chip across the movable boundary while retaining 4–7 chunks; e.g. Na minha infância | eu atravessava essa ponte | todos os dias para voltar | para casa.

findings.issue: No pátio onde você estudou means 'in the yard where you studied', but both glosses ask about the yard at the school where you studied. That is the intended scene geography.

findings.issue: Você ainda se lembra de ligar esse rádio de manhã? can naturally ask 'Do you still remember to turn this radio on in the morning?', a different time and purpose from the retrospective gloss and following answer.

findings.issue: Acertar uma lata means to hit the tin; throwing pebbles at it is only the attempt. The distinction is the entire scoring rule, and the English chunks/terms already say hit.
findings.recommendation: Use our favourite game was trying to hit a tin with pebbles or ...was hitting a tin with pebbles.

findings.issue: A linha direta abriu is awkward as a description of a bus service starting; German nehmen musste also adds necessity to the habitual pegava.
findings.recommendation: Use Quando a linha direta começou a funcionar, passei a sair mais tarde. Adapt both cloze subject cues/blanks; translate pegava as nahm or fuhr mit.

findings.issue: The rule introduces há plus present for ongoing duration, but neither displayed example includes há: the canonical first reply and the extra example both teach only the imperfect half. This leaves the actual new L9 target without an example on the pattern screen.
findings.recommendation: Make the extra example transfer the duration construction to another context, e.g. Trabalho nesta loja há três anos, mas antes trabalhava no centro, with highlight and aligned glosses.

findings.issue: I live here followed by for two years now models the wrong English construction for continuing residence, exactly the cross-language contrast the lesson teaches.
findings.recommendation: Use I’ve lived here / for two years now, matching the full line.

findings.issue: Na primeira fase sounds like a numbered formal project stage, and the story never identifies stages. The natural phase of settling in is the intended trophy sense.
findings.recommendation: Consider Moro aqui faz dois anos, mas na fase de adaptação eu me perdia no centro. Retain fase, gender safety and the word limits.

findings.issue: Esses passeios refers to walks which the learner’s first reply never explicitly mentioned, though the scene is an ongoing walk.
findings.recommendation: Anchor the question in getting lost or finding routes (e.g. E o que ajudou você a conhecer melhor o bairro?) so the shortcut answers it directly.

antes eu pegava vs quando a linha direta abriu, eu passei a sair; 'passar a + infinitivo' is lexical, not a new tense family; DE 'nehmen musste' is idiomatic; direct-line complication not pre-revealed.

lessonsRead.observation: Four causal turns match the infância beat (route, then who accompanied); DE/EN idiomatic; cloze/recall cues subject-tagged; only flaw is the 5-chip build, where the standalone chip todos os dias can also validly precede eu atravessava, so the canonical-order grader falsely rejects a correct sentence.
tinha describes the former state, trouxe/ganhou report the renovation as completed events; trouxemos is a genuine form so the distractor set is fair; captions do not reveal the roof.

ficava + location and plural os bancos ficavam are well staged; recall distractors are lexical (sapato/lençol/forno) and build chips are anchored by the comma and final period, so no alternative order grades falsely.

a gente jogava with 3sg and the gender-free team-forming line (Dois colegas tiravam…) honour the recreio beat; DE 'Wenn viele mitmachen wollten' is a slight paraphrase of aparecia muita gente but idiomatic and not misleading.
Habit (se reunia) versus turning point (vendeu, assumiu) is cleanly contrasted; 'in ein anderes Haus gewandert' reads naturally in German; cloze cues name each subject.
tinha o hábito de + infinitivo stays within P8 (no tinha + particípio); present-tense cloze leio/para for the current habit matches the rule text; o ônibus para is correctly unaccented.

era + infinitive for the usual game, um dia + ensinou for the single occasion, valia for the rule; recall on favorita with agreement distractors is fair; the pebbles caption does not reveal the cousin's rule.
Temporal logic holds (two buses and earlier arrival before; direct line, later departure after); passei a sair is lexical, not a new family; DE Direktverbindung/Umsteigen is idiomatic.

First use of há dois anos is at L9 as licensed; choice gaps dois vs duas and aos vs às/pelas/nas test real agreement/preposition points; 'der Weg kurz' is a fair idiomatic rendering of a distância era pequena, and chunks keep the literal gloss.

faz dois anos plus imperfeito me perdia and the perfeito turning point (mostrou, comecei a caminhar) close the path; caminhar after comecei a is the only possible form among the choices; neighbour's shortcut is not revealed by the caption.

findings.issue: Build grading accepts only the canonical chip order, but with the current five chips the sentence 'Na minha infância todos os dias eu atravessava essa ponte para voltar para casa.' is a fully correct alternative, so a correct learner answer is rejected. Joining the adjacent chips 'essa ponte' + 'todos os dias' removes the ambiguity: capitalised 'Na minha infância' is fixed first, the period-bearing 'para voltar para casa.' is fixed last, and 'eu atravessava' must precede its object, leaving a single valid order. Spoken turn, model, recall, terms and trophy example are unchanged; four chips meet the 4–7 bound.

lessonsRead.observation: Exact-order fix verified: the build now has four chips with 'essa ponte todos os dias' merged, capitalised 'Na minha infância' fixed first and the period chip last, so 'eu atravessava' must precede its object and only one order reconstructs; cloze cues 'esperar (Minha avó)'/'voltar (Minha avó)' tag subjects and DE/EN glosses stay idiomatic.

'no pátio da escola onde você estudou' matches the DE/EN geography; tinha sets the former state while trouxe/ganhou report the renovation as completed events with explicit subject cues; caption does not reveal the roof.

ficava + location and plural os bancos ficavam are correctly contrasted; comma-bearing 'da minha tia,' and period-bearing 'uma mangueira enorme.' lock the build order; cloze jogavam/contava distinguish plural vs singular subjects.

a gente jogava with 3sg verb honours the rule; 'até o sinal tocar' is lexical and the team-forming line (Dois colegas tiravam…formavam) is gender-free; DE 'Wenn viele mitmachen wollten' is a fair idiomatic paraphrase.
Habit (se reunia) versus turning point (vendeu, assumiu) is cleanly staged; cloze cues name 'Minha avó' and 'minha mãe'; recall on reunia with form distractors is fair.

'de quando ligava esse rádio' now reads unambiguously retrospective; tinha o hábito de + infinitivo stays within P8 licensing, and present-tense cloze leio/para (unaccented post-2009) matches the rule's switch to the present.

EN 'trying to hit a tin' now matches acertar; era + infinitive for the usual game, um dia + ensinou for the one occasion, valia with cue 'valer (cada acerto)' excludes valiam; recall on favorita tests agreement fairly.

Temporal logic holds (earlier arrival with two buses before; direct line then later departure); 'pegava' rendered as 'genommen habe' without added necessity; cues 'abrir (a linha direta)' and 'passar (eu)' make both blanks single-answer.

Second example 'Moro nesta rua há três anos, mas antes eu morava perto da praia' now shows the há + present duration the rule introduces; choice gaps dois/duas and aos/às/pelas/nas test real agreement and preposition points with one correct answer each.

faz dois anos + imperfeito me perdia + perfeito turning point (mostrou, comecei a caminhar) closes the path; chunk EN 'I've lived here' now models the correct English construction; caminhar is the only possible form after comecei a among the choices.

findings.issue: 'no pátio onde você estudou' literally locates studying in the yard; adding 'da escola' matches both glosses ('Hof deiner früheren Schule' / 'yard at your old school'). Substring occurs in dialogue/0 and both sceneCaptions.

findings.issue: Interlocutor presumes the lunches moved to the learner's own house ('a sua casa'); the answer only says the mother took over. Neutral wording keeps the causal question without the presumption.

edits.new: E quando foi que esses almoços mudaram de casa?

findings.issue: DE 'nehmen musste' adds obligation that 'eu pegava' does not express; chunk gloss already says 'ich zwei Busse nahm'. Same string duplicated in pattern example 1.

edits.new: dass ich früher zwei Busse zur Arbeit genommen habe.
